Vacancy Notification for Advt. No. 01/2026
1/84
F.No.10(01)/2026-R-I Dated: 13.08.2026
Vacancy Advt. No. 01/2026
ASRB invites online applications for filling up 48 (forty-eight) Research
Management Positions (RMP) as mentioned below to be filled up on tenure basis for
a period of five years by selection at ICAR Headquarters and in different locations at
ICAR Research Institutes. Candidates are required to apply online using the
application form link (https://oasis.asrb.gov.in) available on the website:
https://asrb.gov.in only. No other mode of filling of application is allowed.
General Instructions for the candidates for notified vacancies are mentioned
at pages 57-63 of the Vacancy Notification. The instructions to the candidates for
filling up online applications are given at Annexure-Z (page 64-66). These are
applicable to all candidates and to all posts.
Number of vacancies: Against each Item No. there is only one vacancy.

01. Deputy Director General (Agricultural Engineering), Indian Council of
Agricultural Research Headquarters, New Delhi, Rs.2,10,000/- (Fixed)
Qualifications Essential:
1 Doctoral Degree in any branch of Agricultural Engineering
OR
Doctoral Degree in any branch of Engineering with minimum 15 years of post
Ph. D. research experience in the field of Agricultural Engineering.
2 (I) A Scientist / Teacher having at least 10 years' experience in the grade of
Principal Scientist/Professor or in an equivalent position in Pay Level 14 of 7th
CPC (PB-4 of Rs.37,400-67,000/- with GP Rs. 10,000/- of 6th CPC), out of which
3 years' experience should be in a Research Management Position or 5 years'
experience in positions specified below or 3 years cumulative weighted
experience in RMP (Research Management Position) & specified position, after
giving weightage of 1.0 for service rendered as RMP and 0.6 to service rendered
in positions specified below:
(a) Heads of Divisions at ICAR Institutes,
(b) Heads of Regional Stations of ICAR Institutes,
(c) Project Coordinator; and
(d) Joint Directors of Institutes other than National Institutes / Deemed
Universities (DUs).
OR
(II) A Scientist/ Teacher having at least 10 years’ experience in the grade of
Principal Scientist/Professor or in an equivalent position in Pay Level 14 of 7th
CPC (PB-4 of Rs. 37,400-67,000/- with GP Rs.10,000/- of 6th CPC), out of which
03 years’ experience of working in a scientific post/ rank in Pay Level 15 of 7th
CPC or equivalent or above in Central Government/ state Government or its
Statutory/Autonomous/Attached Bodies etc.
OR
(III) An ‘Eminent Scientist’ having proven record of scientific contributions
working in a reputed Organization/Institute currently occupying in regular
capacity the post/grade of Principal Scientist/Professor or in an equivalent
position in Pay Level 14 of 7th CPC (PB-4 of Rs. 37,400-67,000/- with GP
Rs.10,000/- of 6th CPC) and having at least 21 years total experience in the
relevant subject/ field. Under this alternative qualification of “Eminent
Scientist”, all those candidates shall be considered who have been decorated
with:
(i) National/International awards/ recognitions as listed in Annexure-
1;
(ii) Fellows of one of the reputed National/International Academies as
listed in Annexure-2;
(iii) Minimum of 10 publications in journals having NAAS rating (latest)
of 8.0 and above (The NAAS ratings as available on closing date of
the applications for posts advertised shall be applicable); and

(iv) Experience of leading/coordinating National/International multi-
institutional and multi-disciplinary project/program in National/
International Organization for a minimum period of 03 years as
substantiated by documentary evidences
* Annexure -1 and Annexure – 2 are enclosed
Note: 1- All four conditions should be simultaneously met by the applicant to
qualify under Eminent Scientist’ category.
Note-2- The requisite length of service, experience, latest NAAS ratings etc shall
be reckoned from the closing date for receipt of applications indicated
in the advertisement.
OR
(IV) Minimum 25 years of post-Ph.D. research/academic experience including

General/DDG of CGIAR or other international organizations
3 Evidence of publication/activities contribution to suggest that the candidate
has a broad vision/perspective on agricultural research.
Desirable: - Research Experience and broad vision with perspective on
Agricultural Engineering research, education, extension and human resource
management.
Research Management, Coordination and Policy Experience in the field of
Agricultural Engineering.
Leadership in multi-disciplinary / multi-institutional R&D initiatives in
relevant fields.
